blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Verified Etherlink implementation prevents transfers involving blacklisted senders or recipients. At Etherlink block 54792510 the issuer EOA 0x1bb0b2666edd827f74b558136fdbe69e4ecec5fd holds BLACKLIST_ROLE; Base and Arbitrum membership is also true at their pinned blocks. Ethereum has the same blacklist surface but that EOA is not a current BLACKLIST_ROLE holder; its DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can authorize roles. Issuance control is separately scoped to native Etherlink.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Etherlink supplies the native issuer liability; current issuer documentation identifies Ethereum, Base and Arbitrum as LayerZero V2 OFT interoperable deployments. Bridge token mint/burn, peer/DVN configuration and satellite upgrade/admin powers remain separately chargeable. Full live adapter inventory, validation thresholds and rate-limit governance are unresolved.
